hints.title: Hierarchical Lexical Scope Resolution
hints.text: Parenthesized expressions define nested scopes where let-bindings overshadow outer variable definitions during expression evaluation.

hints.title: Tokenization and Operator Branching
hints.text: Split the inner expression by top-level whitespace respecting nested parentheses. Determine if operator is let, add, or mult.

hints.title: Recursive Expression Evaluator Blueprint
hints.text: Maintain an environment dict mapping variable names to value sequences. On let: bind variables sequentially, then evaluate trailing expression. On add: eval(e1) + eval(e2). On mult: eval(e1) * eval(e2).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Substring token slicing at each nested scope produces quadratic worst-case time with linear scope depth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard left-to-right evaluation confuses variable scopes across sub-expressions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scoped dictionary frames accurately isolate temporary variable shadowed states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct token splitting respecting nested parentheses and lexical shadowing.

solutions.approach: Recursive Descent Parser with Scoped Symbol Table
